primary_result: The SHA-bound revised S1 development-screening qualification passed evidence identity, archived scene coverage, and measurement-null validity, but local utility over global and bidirectional repeatability were both unfavorable. Under the frozen valid_utility_failure decision rule, these decisive outcomes establish COMPLETED_GATE_FAIL and authorize no S2, model change, training, deployment, or scientific promotion.
gate_reasons: The evidence_identity, archived_scene_coverage, and measurement_null_artifact validity-veto gates all passed, so no validity veto forced an inconclusive terminal.
The local_utility_over_global gate was unfavorable under the archived, unchanged S1 scientific outcomes.
The bidirectional_repeatability gate was unfavorable under the archived, unchanged S1 scientific outcomes.
The near_clear_fidelity gate was indeterminate, but it does not override the two decisive unfavorable utility gates in the frozen valid_utility_failure row.
Archived primary precision was met, while auxiliary precision was unmet. The combined primary_precision gate is inconclusive_only and cannot hide a decisive scientific FAIL.
competing_explanation: The uncertainty-qualified edge/interior summaries show spatial heterogeneity, including positive overall edge-local and edge-minus-interior advantages, and the revised null diagnostic found no affirmative measurement artifact. These descriptive patterns do not override the frozen unfavorable local-utility and bidirectional-repeatability gates, and the absent scoring-crop-side field prevents attributing them to a crop-boundary effect.
limitations: This is a SHA-bound reanalysis of archived development-screening evidence, not an independent confirmation experiment.
Historical v2 estimates, thresholds, gate outcomes, and terminal evidence were not modified.
The archived scene table does not contain scoring-crop side, so padded full-image area cannot be interpreted as crop size.
Edge/interior intervals are descriptive and cannot by themselves establish a crop-boundary artifact.
No model, checkpoint, image, array, protected data, training, inference, S2 activity, or deployment was involved.
